paras.en: A value that appears most often in a data set is called mode. For example, x = 3, 6, 5, 3, 2. As the value 3 appears most number of time i.e. twice and remaining values occur only once so Mode = 3. Sometimes a data set may have no mode or may have more than one mode, whereas, it will have only one mean and only one median. A data set with each value occurring only once has no mode.
